thread:
samir: Quick Q from the all-hands: can someone spell out the new release rhythm and any special rules for customer-critical services?
olivia: Short: minor releases every 3 weeks, majors once a month. New addition: "flex-windows" for customer-critical services where teams coordinate directly with accounts for timing.
diego: What exactly are flex-windows?
olivia: Flex-windows = agreed 48h windows with the customer where we can schedule higher-risk changes with their consent. Requires account & legal sign-off, and SRE presence.
ceo-jess: Also: we want auto-rollback enabled where safe. If runbook conditions hit (error-rate spike or synthetic failures), the deploy tool should auto-revert to previous tag unless explicitly disabled in the ticket.
ops-bot: Reminder: auto-rollback defaults ON. To disable, add `rollback:false` in the release meta and get ops approval.
infra: Canary guidance: start 5% for 2h, then 20% for 6h before full ramp for low-risk services. For high-risk or customer-facing routes use 10% -> 30% -> hold 12h.
samir: Who needs to be on the bridge for canaries?
olivia: Eng lead + SRE lead + product owner. For flex-windows include the customer success rep. Also require a shadow oncall for the first 24h of a high-risk ramp.
diego: Quality bars — any numeric cutoffs? p99/p95? test coverage?
infra: Must have unit+integration green, staging e2e green, load smoke (k=1k users) pass, and perf: p99 <= 15% regression, p95 <= 10% vs baseline. Test coverage not a hard gate but include testing notes in the ticket.
sales: For renewals, customers ask if cadence means more instability. What's the message?
ceo-jess: Message: more predictable releases + stronger automation and monitoring. No SLA changes. We'll publish a short customer note: cadence, flex-window option, and our rollback+SLO commitments. Docs to draft.
docswriter: I'll draft internal checklist + customer blurb. Can reviewers from ops/sales please ping me once it's ready?
ops-bot: Please file a canary runbook in the release ticket and tag @ops 24h prior. Use tag format `release/<service>/v<semver>-<date>`.
samir: Small ask: can we add a 10-15m async retro template after each release to capture rollbacks/lessons?
olivia: Yes — adding a mandatory short async retro for any release that hits rollback, optional lightweight template for all others. I'll update the handbook and open a PR by EOD Tuesday.
diego: Example deploy command (CLI): `rwdctl deploy --svc embeddings --tag v2.3.1-20260315 --canary 10 --auto-rollback=true --notify ops`
sales: Thanks, this helps. Ping us when the customer blurb is ready so we can share with AEs.
ceo-jess: Thanks everyone. Important we keep release names consistent and keep oncall overhead predictable. Appreciate the rapid follow-up. :rocket:
